do: Assemble in this order: <DataTable> > <TableTitle> > <TableHeaderRow> of <TableHeader> > <TableRow> of <DataTableCell>.
TableTitle shows only the title by default; pass actions (or showAction for the placeholder buttons) and showTooltip + tooltip when you need them.
Set TableRow variant (white | grey | selected) to alternate rows or mark a selection; add interactive for hover and pressed states.
dont: Don't ship showAction without actions: the default buttons are labelled "Action verb".
Don't rebuild a data table from raw table parts — use table only for simple static tables.

whenToUseInstead.when: a simple static table with no title bar, sorting or cell types
